## Related native graph verification — progress, not closure

Two actual direct **cargo-audit0.22.2** scans now pass (exit0) for the complete committed **93picker/48share** lockfile unions: zero matched vulnerabilities and zero warnings. All targets and informational warnings are included; no ignore/severity/stale filters; `--deny warnings`, with no yanked-skip flag.

The clean RustSec database is independently Git/byte-bound to `40f5be6fb12ed93fc591bf4ab23b7d793b3f2239`: **1381advisories =1361crate +20Rust-toolchain** records. Scans use `--no-fetch`; the tool's JSON commit/time fields are null, so the separate Git binding is explicit rather than invented metadata. Five production manifest/lock/toolchain inputs are held and exactly bound to `675394815f69bcd6a75bfd3227992a983b5db0b7`. The prior92unique-coordinate OSV zero-match result is separate evidence.

**This issue stays OPEN:** real Linux portal open/save/folder/multiple selection/cancellation and supported desktop/session-bus functionality remain independent acceptance requirements. Existing config/JNI or open/cancel tests are not the complete matrix. No full dependency/bootstrap/provenance/license/consumer/ABI/minimum-platform/security/release gate is cleared, and no packages/releases/deployments/Pages are requested.

Detailed additive reports are in `docs/development/evidence/native-security-batch-important-20261029/direct-rustsec001/`.
